2608.19746.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
2608.19746.paper_summary: Personalized text generation aims to make LLMs write in a specific individual's style, yet existing benchmarks measure task accuracy or preference alignment rather than whether the model's output actually resembles the target author's writing. We introduce PersonalBench, a benchmark that evaluates inference-time personalization methods through three independent lenses: LUAR (a trained authorship verification model), an LLM-as-judge, and automated stylometrics. Across 50 authors, 1,000 generations, and two model families (Qwen 3, GLM-4), we find that personalization methods do produce author-differentiated output (LUAR discriminates target authors within generated text at AUC=0.918) but this differentiation never crosses the human-LLM boundary. All methods achieve LUAR similarity to real authors in the range 0.484-0.508, below the cross-author human floor of 0.626 (ceiling 0.756). The LLM's own authorship fingerprint dominates: generated text is more distant from any human author than random humans are from each other. Methods are statistically indistinguishable from each other on LUAR (spread 0.024) despite appearing differentiated on the LLM judge, a discrepancy we trace to circularity between trait extraction and profile extraction. We validate that LUAR reliably measures authorship in our corpus (AUC=0.76 single-post, 0.96 multi-post). We release PersonalBench as a calibrated measuring stick: inference-time personalization modulates the LLM's style but does not bridge the gap to human authorship.
2608.19746.paper_summary_zh: 個性化文本生成旨在使大型語言模型（LLMs）以特定個體的風格進行寫作，但現有基準測量的是任務準確性或偏好一致性，而不是模型的輸出是否實際上類似於目標作者的寫作。我們介紹了 PersonalBench，一個通過三個獨立的視角評估推理時個性化方法的基準：LUAR（訓練過的作者身份驗證模型）、LLM作為評判者，以及自動風格度量。在50位作者、1,000次生成和兩個模型系列（Qwen 3，GLM-4）中，我們發現個性化方法確實產生了作者區分的輸出（LUAR在生成文本中區分目標作者的AUC為0.918），但這種區分從未跨越人類與LLM的邊界。所有方法在LUAR的相似度範圍為0.484-0.508，低於跨作者人類的底線0.626（上限0.756）。LLM自身的作者指紋占主導地位：生成的文本與任何人類作者的距離比隨機人類之間的距離更遠。儘管在LLM評判者上看似有區分，但在LUAR上這些方法在統計上無法區分（差異0.024），我們將這一差異追溯到特徵提取和檔案提取之間的循環性。我們驗證了LUAR在我們的語料庫中可靠地測量作者身份（單篇文章AUC=0.76，多篇文章0.96）。我們發布PersonalBench作為一個經過校準的測量工具：推理時的個性化調整了LLM的風格，但並未縮小與人類作者之間的差距。
